summaries.title: ABC-Bench: Benchmarking Agentic Backend Coding in Real-World Development

summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 65 赞，出自 OpenMOSS），本工作可作为评估 **软件工程与代码智能体 (SWE & Coding)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: NAACL: Noise-AwAre Verbal Confidence Calibration for LLMs in RAG Systems
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **NAACL** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)）、检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)），并引入 While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To address this, we propose NAACL Rules (Noise-AwAre Confidence CaLibration Rules) to provide a principled foundation for resolving overconfidence under noise。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We conduct a systematic study across four benchmarks, revealing that LLMs exhibit poor calibration performance due to noisy retrieved contexts。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **10.9%, 8.0%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Empirical results show that NAACL yields substantial gains, improving ECE scores by 10.9% in-domain and 8.0% out-of-domain）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 30 赞），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、检索增强与长程持续记忆 (RAG & Continual Memory)** 中的「系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: SIN-Bench: Tracing Native Evidence Chains in Long-Context Multimodal Scientific Interleaved Literature
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **SIN-Bench** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)）。核心论点主张：We propose the "Fish-in-the-Ocean" (FITO) paradigm, which requires models to construct explicit cross-modal evidence chains within native scientific documents。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To operationalize FITO, we build SIN-Data, a scientific interleaved corpus that preserves the native interleaving of text and figures。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experiments on eight MLLMs show that grounding is the primary bottleneck: Gemini-3-pro achieves the best average overall score (0.573), while GPT-5 attains the highest SIN-QA answer...）。
